How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the OPSC Ayurvedic Medical Officer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of OPSC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OPSC Ayurvedic Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications for the OPSC Ayurvedic Medical Officer recruitment is 09 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Ayurvedic Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor Degree in Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution and be registered with the Odisha State Council of Ayurvedic Medicines. Completion of internship is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Ayurvedic Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 32 vacancies for the post of Ayurvedic Medical Officer announced by the Odisha Public Service Commission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for OPSC Ayurvedic Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 700/- for General/OBC candidates. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Written Examination of Objective Type. Candidates who qualify in the written exam will be considered for appointment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Ayurvedic Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 44,900/- per month, which is as per Level 10, Cell-1 of the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q8. When will the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process for the OPSC Ayurvedic Medical Officer recruitment will commence on 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article or directly from the OPSC official website. It is recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. There is a 5-year relaxation for SEBC/SC/ST/Women/Ex-Servicemen, 10 years for PwD, and a cumulative relaxation of up to 15 years for PwD belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories.
